our_side: Three Armada seats on the east strip: t1 G1 (record-0, team 1), t2 H8 (record-1, team 2), t3 G4 (record-2, team 3); one player, claude-opus-5-5 at effort medium (Claude Code 2.1.283), ordering all three; no commander layer; hands Jev jev-latest = jev-1.13.0 on each seat; realtime; banner names MoustacheG, rossco, MonkeyLord (seat mapping not checked)
summary: Three Armada seats of ours (one Opus 5.5 medium player) on Comet Catcher's east strip lost to thebluegecko at 20:27, all three commanders dead (15:53 H2, 19:03 H7, 20:27 G4). The trade was level at 8:00 (2,707 of ours lost against 2,706 of his seen die); then the player turned two Blitz dives on his commander at his plant (5:15, 7:17-8:16: 23 units to the D-gun) and sent single groups into his Janus and Stouts (c3_outpost 10:16, E3 12:09), losing 12.9k for 4.6k from 8:00 to 13:00. From 11:00 our army (8-14k against a seen floor of 0.5-4.4k) never stood in his half again, and he walked Stout-Janus blocks round it: north to G1 (14:55-16:11), then with 30 Rovers along the south edge to H8 (16:38-19:03), while our ball stood at F4, spot_20 and, stalled by a stale march goal, spot_10. Both lost commanders were walked back into the block by go-home plays (harness, since fixed), and six or seven Bulls (first 18:33) took the last seat against no tier 2 of ours. Counted once by unit id across the three records, his destroyed was 25.2k against our 52.7k lost: the 'ahead on the trade' reading of the ledger, the player's report and the existing review rests on the report's triple counting.

root.what: The first lead (3.3k of Blitzes and Rovers across the seats against 31 seen at 5:00, the trade still even) was turned on his commander at his plant: 5:15 'THE KILL ... attack_unit the commander with every soldier', the hands' 5:19 hunt of 8 Blitzes onto the commander's party, and the 5:33 lesson drawn wrong ('Gathering 27 Blitzes ... before a single combined attack_unit'), which became the 47-Blitz attack of 7:17 and the 8:08 'NO RETREAT'. A stronger player keeps Blitzes off a D-gun at its plant, spends the lead on his outer extractors and constructors, and switches the plants at his first Janus (6:39). The 8:23 retreat to our half, the piecemeal fights and the seats lost one by one are its cost. Reader's reading; no person commented on this game.

lens.caveats: No truth file, results.jsonl or batch.json: his army, economy and losses are what we saw (floors). minutes.py, analyze_match, pro_baseline and floor read record-0 only, so seats 1 and 2 were read through scratchpad directories of symlinks and the jev logs decompressed from .zst; pro_baseline has no pool for G1/H8 and its pressure rows read '-'; raid_ledger 'answered 0' on every seat is the tool's pattern; floor's jev columns exist for seat 0 only. games.jsonl lists our_seats 2, but the header has three seats of ours (team 1's controller recorded Unknown). The chat holds only our banners: no person's line and no computer_whisperer line, so every 'because' here is the reader's or the player's notes. Differs from review.md (Fable 5.1, 2026-09-26): its 'you won every fight you chose' and '56.7k destroyed to 33.5k lost at 16:16' rest on the triple-counted trade (18.9k to 33.7k counted once); its decisive moment 13:58 is here a turning point and the root is 5:15; the 8:23 'never toward enemy_plant' was prose that reached no group (d64864a), so the army's stay in our half was the player's stations and its standing never on spot_36/spot_38.
